cover.why: I am a huge advocate for health and wellness. I saw the video on your website and I thought this would be a great chance for me to apply my skills to something that can help others achieve their goals and helping to build a healthier America.
I like how you guys seem to be involved in different industries. Things like government and land preservation. I also thought the Alaskan native roots was pretty cool.

I like how you guys seem to be involved in different industries that work with US military. In particular, your data and cyber initiatives are things that I would be interested in. I have a lot of tech skills and engineering skills that I would position me to grow into more impactful roles down the line.

I am particularly interested in this company's effort to build the Tampa Bay community with providing homes for the homeless, helping children or providing food. Being able to optimize KPI's for donors that help in that effort would be an honor.

The Technical Writer position with Olgoonik Corporation combines my passion for translating complex technical information into clear, user-friendly content. My background in technical communication, content development, and working with diverse audiences aligns well with Olgoonik's focus on supporting mission-critical government and commercial projects. I am particularly drawn to the opportunity to contribute to a company known for delivering high-quality professional services while continuing to develop my skills in a collaborative and technically focused environment.
